def: to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account)

occurrences.text: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
